finding.problem: difference() intersects with the flipped-flag complement, so with OR it keeps points the subtrahend removes (difference([(0,1)], [(1,2)]) returns [(0,1,True,True)]) and can emit a closed unbounded end (difference([(None,5,False,False)], [(10,20)]) returns (None,5,True,False)), which parse() then rejects on round-trip.
